d:
A second murder has taken place in Punjab within 24 hours—first in Moga, and now in Amritsar. The pattern of the crime is the same, though the individuals involved are different. On October 26, the son of an Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) sarpanch was shot dead in Amritsar. As he was returning after offering prayers at a gurdwara, assailants opened indiscriminate fire on him. Upon being taken to the hospital, he was declared dead by the doctors. A friend of his was also injured in the incident.
